column1: # Total basis: whole-image AOT range manifest.

column2: function start — UpdateFramebufferRadialRippleDissolve; advances ripple phase amplitude age depth translation and the delayed grayscale fade.
function start — DrawFramebufferRadialRippleDissolve; applies distance-phased sinusoidal depth and grayscale then projects and submits all 560 textured triangles.
function start — SynchronizeAndFreeFramebufferRippleState; waits for GPU drawing to finish and frees the large ripple mesh allocation.
function start — DeleteFramebufferRippleTask; removes task and timer registrations and queues the task allocation for deferred release.
function start — CreateFramebufferRippleMesh; allocates the mesh state initializes its object pointers and builds the complete ripple mesh.
function start — InitializeFramebufferRippleMesh; constructs a 20 by 14 screenshot mesh and derives each vertex's initial radial phase from its center distance.
function start — RunFramebufferRippleTransitionOnTemporaryStack; runs the complete ripple transition on an allocated temporary stack then restores and frees it.
function start — RunFramebufferRadialRippleDissolve; captures the framebuffer runs the semitransparent ripple and fade loop restores VRAM and releases temporary resources.
